title: Pi Atelier configuration
description: User file: <agent-dir>/extensions/pi-atelier.json. Trusted project file: <cwd>/.pi/extensions/pi-atelier.json. Project values override user values except where a key is marked user-only.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor completion and validation; ignored at runtime.

preset.description: Status Rail display template. A named preset sets density and segmentLayout; later keys in the same file refine it, and the resolved preset becomes "custom" when they differ from the template.

segmentLayout.description: Status Rail segments in display order with their visibility. Segments left out are appended hidden.

segments.description: Legacy list of visible Status Rail segments in order; read only when segmentLayout is absent. Use segmentLayout.

ornament.description: Legacy brand ornament; "restrained" shows the brand segment on non-editorial presets. Read only when segmentLayout is absent. Use segmentLayout.

showExtensionStatuses.description: Legacy toggle for the statuses segment; read only when segmentLayout is absent. Use segmentLayout.

nerdFont.description: Use Nerd Font glyphs instead of plain-text glyphs. User file only; ignored in project config.

shortcut.description: Shortcut that opens the Atelier menu. "alt+a" (the former default) is replaced by the current default.

toggleShortcut.description: Optional shortcut that toggles the sidebar; an empty string leaves it unbound.

contextWarning.description: Context usage percentage that shows the warning color; must be below contextDanger.

contextDanger.description: Context usage percentage that shows the danger color; must be above contextWarning and at most 100.

showSidebarToolNames.description: Show tool names in the sidebar activity panel.

showSidebarOnStartup.description: Open the sidebar when a session starts. User file only; ignored in project config.

sidebarWidth.description: Sidebar width in columns; out-of-range values are clamped. User file only; ignored in project config.

sidebarStyle.description: Sidebar panel chrome. User file only; ignored in project config.

sidebarPanelLayout.description: Sidebar panels in display order with their visibility. Built-in panels left out are inserted beside their product-order neighbours. User file only; ignored in project config.

id.description: Built-in panel id, or an extension-contributed id of the form "namespace:panel" (for example "orchestrator:fleet").

showSidebarAgent.description: Legacy Agent panel visibility; read only from the user file when sidebarPanelLayout is absent. Use sidebarPanelLayout.

showSidebarTodos.description: Legacy TODOS panel visibility; read only from the user file when sidebarPanelLayout is absent. Use sidebarPanelLayout.

extensionStatusOrder.description: Extension status keys (as passed to setStatus()) listed first, in this order; unlisted statuses keep Pi's order.

completionNotifications.description: Send a desktop notification when a run completes or input is requested. User file only; ignored in project config.

showFooter.description: Show the Atelier footer (Status Rail). User file only; ignored in project config.

prefillViews.description: Rows the prefill panel shows, in order.

prefillProviders.description: Providers whose requests get prefill progress reporting. User file only; ignored in project config.
